recovery.independent_reconciliation_requirement: Fenced controller restart, fresh actual train integrity/readiness, retained forward locks and a proved new authority; stopped software reconciliation is not physical winch/coupling qualification.
recovery.off_powered_zone_failure_action: Retain authority, stop following launches, secure the consist and require a located proved rescue/powered asset; time shift alone never supplies restart thrust.
recovery.support_failed_recovery_requirement: Qualified contact support plus low-friction recovery dollies/jacking or a separately sized heavy towing system; the levitated constant-drag rope calculation does not cover sliding capture pads.

equal_cycle_train_price_break_even.reason: At an unchanged cycle and no rounding,120s needs1.5times the180s fleet, so unit price must fall byone-third just to hold fleet purchase cost.

fleet.cost_claim: Low-cost trainsets are a design objective, not a verified price. Fleet arithmetic does not include revised depot, chargers, crews, renewals or financing.
